rationale.intervention_reconstruction: The hypothesis proposes thermal aging of an AlCoCrFeNi2.1 eutectic HEA, while the target uses spark plasma sintering of a MgAlTiVFeCo powder. These are fundamentally different kinds of interventions (aging vs. sintering) on completely different alloy systems.
rationale.condition_agreement: The hypothesis specifies aging at 550-750°C for embrittlement/recovery, whereas the target involves sintering at 800-1000°C, oxidation at 900°C in air, and corrosion in 3.5 wt% NaCl. The temperature regimes and environments are entirely different.
rationale.mechanism_agreement: The hypothesis describes L12 ordering, jagged phase boundaries, and planar slip leading to ductile-brittle transitions. The target mechanism involves diffusion-driven formation of oxide barrier phases, passive film growth, and parabolic oxidation kinetics. These are unrelated mechanism classes.
rationale.outcome_agreement: The hypothesis predicts a non-monotonic ductile-brittle-ductile transition in mechanical properties. The target predicts optimal density, hardness, and corrosion/oxidation resistance at 1000°C. The predicted properties and directions are completely different.
